1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.207/2018 registered under Sections 498A/323/506 IPC at PS Bajpur, Udham Singh Nagar, Uttarakhand, on the ground of a settlement between the parties vide MOU dated 22.09.2022 arrived at before the Family Court, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi, which is on record of this Court.

entities.text: Family Court, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As per the settlement, a balance amount of Rs.8,40,000/- is to be paid at this stage, which is being tendered vide a DD bearing No.194139 dated 22.02.2023 for Rs.8,40,000/- drawn on Citibank and handed over to respondent No.3, who is present in the Court and has duly received and acknowledged the same.
Petitioner Nos.1 - 3 are also present in the Court, duly identified by the counsel.
2. Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.3 were married on 09.07.2016.
No child was born out of the wedlock and due to differences between the parties, their marriage has resulted into a divorce vide a decree dated 16.02.2023.

3. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.207/2018 registered under Sections 498A/323/506 IPC at PS Bajpur, Udham Singh Nagar, Uttarakhand, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
